cohort: Postpartum women in Jiangsu Province, China (n=6,302)
finding: The prevalence of postpartum stress urinary incontinence in Jiangsu Province was 25.06%, and was associated with being overweight, parity > 2, coexisting organ prolapse, constipation, and a decrease in the mean value of the endurance contraction phase of the electromyograph.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was associated with the prevalence of postpartum stress urinary incontinence.
